title: Google offers Anthropic up to $30B more in funding

sources.quote: In May 2026 (unaudited), Google invested $10.0 billion in the Company’s Series H redeemable convertible preferred stock financing, which reduced the amount available for issuance under the Google 2026 NPA to $20.0 billion.
The Alphabet Inc.-owned company will invest another $30 billion if Anthropic hits performance targets

explain: On top of its $10 billion share purchase, Google agreed to provide up to $30 billion more in debt or equity through 2030, tied to Anthropic hitting compute and revenue targets. Google used $10 billion of it to join Anthropic's Series H round, leaving $20 billion.
